sciencedaily.title: Why two-sun planets keep disappearing scientists blame Einstein
sciencedaily.summary: Astronomers have long been puzzled by a cosmic mystery: planets orbiting two stars—like Star Wars' Tatooine—are surprisingly rare, even though they should be common. New research suggests the culprit is none other than Einstein's theory of general relativity, which causes orbital instabilities that either eject planets or lead to their destruction.
